chunks: Yet they say: 'There is nothing but the life of this world. We die and we live, and only time annihilates us.' Yet they have no knowledge of this: They only speculate.
ai.seo_question: What do polytheists believe about death and life according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to critique the materialist worldview of the Jahiliyyah, where 'al-dahr' (time) is personified as the sole agent of creation and destruction, ignoring Allah's will. It underscores that their assertion is merely conjecture (zann) rather than knowledge (ilm), serving as a foundational argument for the inevitability of bodily resurrection and the Day of Judgment.
